thread:
vivian: quick heads-up — noticed intermittent 20-40% p99 latency spikes on the causal flash/Sdpa stack when running int8 workloads. only shows up on nightly repros with head_dim in the low 20s.

matt: can you share the minimal repro and the kernel chooser log? is this new after the tiling heuristic change?

vivian: yep repro script below. seems to flip kernel choice between flashv3_causal and sdpa_noncausal_probed depending on small seq_len/head_dim combos. repro: `./bench/serve_perf --model llama-7b-q4 --seq 512 --batch 1 --head-dim 22 --quant int8 --warmup 0`

leo: paste of kernel-chooser log from the run:

```
CHOOSER: model=llama-7b-q4 seq=512 heads=48 head_dim=22 arch=sm90
PROBE: flashv3_causal score=112.4ms
PROBE: sdpa_noncausal_probed score=96.7ms
DECIDE: selected sdpa_noncausal_probed (heuristic_delta=-15.7)
RUNTIME: executing sdpa_noncausal_probed kernel
```

leo: that looks wrong — it should not pick non-causal for a causal request. the chooser is (incorrectly) zeroing causal penalty when head_dim % tile_size triggers an alternate tiling branch. rounding in the tiler weight calc seems to undercount causal overhead for small head widths.

nia: interesting — I saw a similar pattern on SM86 vs SM90: the microbenchmark on SM86 penalizes sdpa_noncausal more, so chooser stays on flashv3_causal there. CI didn't catch because our nightly uses an SM86 runner.

infra-ci: deploy bot: nightly-perf-run detected 33% regression in causal throughput for bench/llama-7b-q4 (head_dim=22) on runner sm90-rt. Link: https://perf.redwood.example/runs/3111112222

matt: thanks. can you attach the profiler flame? curious whether the KV-cache path also contributes.

vivian: flame attached in gist (short):

```
# flame summary
flashv3_causal: total 80ms (kernel 60ms, kv-cache sync 12ms, misc 8ms)
sdpa_noncausal_probed: total 95ms (kernel 85ms, kv-cache sync 6ms, misc 4ms)
```

vivian: kernel latencies are noisy; chooser picks sdpa_noncausal because microprobe measured lower raw kernel time but forgot to include the causal mask handling cost on the hot path. plus int8 path has a tiny extra packing step that flips marginally for certain head_dim alignments.

leo: quick mitigation: add a small causal_penalty fudge when head_dim < 32 or when head_dim % 8 != 0. that keeps chooser stable until we fix tiler accuracy. PR idea: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5234

nia: do we want an immediate runtime override env var? e.g. `REDBOX_KERNEL_PREFERENCE=flashv3_causal` so hosts can opt-out of the new heuristic for now.

vivian: yes please. I have a patch to read FORCE_KERNEL or REDBOX_KERNEL_PREFERENCE. will open a small internal config PR and notify ops.

matt: long-term we should fix the tiler to include exact causal masking accounting and int8 pack/unpack microlatency in the probe score. candidate tasks: (1) extend microprobe to run with causal-mask enabled for biased probes, (2) add head_dim-alignment-aware tile cost model, (3) add regression tests for head dims 16-31 across SM86/SM90.

leo: agreed. I'll take (1) and (2) and add a unit test that exhausts head_dim range 8..64 in the autotuner harness.

infra-ci: note: adding a matrix job for sm90 runners will help catch these early. filing infra ticket.

vivian: thanks all — toggled temporary override on the affected fleet and the spike went away in canary. i'll follow up with a formal postmortem + perf diff once PR lands. :thumbsup:

srebot: alert cleared: causal-latency-spike (run 3111112222) — canary pass observed in 12m.

vivian: filing follow-up issue: runtime#6137 (heuristic: tiler causal accounting small-heads).
